'''The Maze''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] located on a [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was in business during parts of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
